search.label: Google Search
search.src: Retail Home & Garden Search CPC $1.28 (COREPPC via Webtonic, 2026); $1.50 to $3.00 CPC, 3.5% to 5.5% CVR (Webtonic, 2026). Base CPC $1.75 is the agent's midpoint. Not the $8.33 'home improvement' figure, which is contractor lead gen.

pmax.label: Performance Max + local inventory
pmax.src: Shopping Home & Garden CPC $1.05, CVR 2.9% (FoundryCRO 2026); Shopping CPC $0.61 (COREPPC 2026); CVR 2.1% (OwlClaw); PMax runs about 14% above Shopping CPC (FoundryCRO). High CVR 3.5% is an agent assumption.

meta.label: Meta (Facebook, Instagram)
meta.src: Home & Home Improvement traffic CPC $0.63 (WordStream 2026 via Coupler.io); Home & Garden CPC $1.10 (ContentStudio 2026); purchase CVR median about 1.5% (ContentStudio 2026). CVR spread is the agent's.

tiktok.label: TikTok
tiktok.src: TikTok CTR 1.77%, CPM $13.26, CVR 2.01% (Whatagraph 2026). CPC = CPM / (1,000 x CTR) = $0.75. Spread of 30% is the agent's.

nextdoor.label: Nextdoor
nextdoor.src: No public Nextdoor benchmark found (searched Oct 19, 2026). Treated as a learning test; numbers are agent assumptions.

campaigns.name: Gutter Gear Before The Rain
campaigns.theme: Gutter and drainage bundle, timed to each forecast storm this El Niño winter
campaigns.trigger: NWS rain in the 72-hour forecast for a store zone; burst starts 48 hours before, pauses during heavy rain
campaigns.geo: All four trade areas; weight by owner-occupied homes (Petaluma 63.9%, Sonoma 63.1%, Santa Rosa 56.2%, Ukiah 45.8%)
campaigns.landing: Gutters & Drainage category with store pickup; storm-prep post with estimator
creative: IT'S TIME TO... CLEAR THE GUTTERS / Get Your Gutters Ready For The Rain / SHOP GUTTER GEAR
STOP THE OVERFLOW / Send Downspout Water Away From The House / SHOP DRAINAGE
Spanish variant (separate line): PREPÁRESE PARA LA LLUVIA / SHOP GUTTER GEAR
campaigns.hypothesis: Bursts timed 48 hours before forecast rain beat steady daily spend on ROAS by at least 25%.
campaigns.basket_note: ASSUMPTION: about 60 ft of gutter (20 three-foot guard sections), two downspouts and a tube of sealant for leaky seams. Confirm with POS baskets.
held: 2298786 Amerimax gutter guard: Santa Rosa went from 84 on Oct 18 to 71 on Oct 19, so it's already moving fast ahead of the rain, and a job uses about 20 sections. Buyers confirm inbound before launch, or the agent caps Search

campaigns.name: Winterize Before The Frost
campaigns.theme: Faucet covers, pipe insulation and door weatherstripping before the first inland frost
campaigns.trigger: NWS frost advisory for North Bay interior valleys or Ukiah; send 24 to 48 hours ahead
campaigns.flight: Email and SMS on frost forecasts, Nov 1 to Dec 15, 2026
campaigns.geo: Ukiah and Sonoma Valley first (earlier frost), then Santa Rosa and Petaluma
campaigns.landing: Content agent's winterize post with estimator
creative: IT'S TIME TO... WINTERIZE / Cover Faucets Before The First Frost / SHOP PLUMBING
SMS: Frost tonight in the valley. Cover outdoor faucets and wrap pipes. Pickup at Friedman's: [link] Reply STOP to opt out.
campaigns.hypothesis: Frost-triggered SMS to opted-in Ukiah customers drives more pickup orders per message than a calendar-timed send.
campaigns.basket_note: ASSUMPTION: two faucets, 18 ft of pipe, one door. Basket value is too low for paid clicks to break even.
held: 209001007 Frost King faucet cover: 93 at Ukiah, the deepest stock, so Ukiah messages lead with it
